window_title: TVox - FMV Modding Studio (Powered by TStudio Engine)
stt_btn_tooltip: Transcribe audio to a draft subtitle (Whisper via thaistt) — fully local
stt_btn_disabled_tooltip: Not configured — open Tools → Settings → thaistt CLI field to enable
stt_need_setup_msg: Set the thaistt path first in Tools → Settings → 'thaistt CLI' (it manages ffmpeg/models itself — works offline afterwards)
stt_workflow_warning: ⚠️ Recommend reviewing/fixing the transcript before translating — wrong transcript = wrong translation
stt_need_subtitles_tool: Game Tool 'Subtitles' is not installed — open Plugin Manager → Game Tools tab and install Subtitles first
stt_opened_status: Draft opened in table: {csv} ({n} rows) — origin bound to the SRT
tts_btn_tooltip: Auto-generate Thai voice-over with AI TTS (edge-tts) — creates per-row WAV from Translation column
tts_no_translations: No Thai translations in the table — translate first
tts_need_install: edge-tts not installed — run pip install edge-tts in TStudio venv
tts_need_ffmpeg: ffmpeg not found — install with brew install ffmpeg
tts_all_failed: All rows failed — check internet connection (edge-tts requires network)
tts_no_wav: 🔇 No audio file yet (press 🎙️ to generate first)
tvox_player_qt_info:
🎬 Video player is using the built-in engine (Qt · FFmpeg) — mpv is broken on macOS (known bug), temporarily switched.

All features work: play/pause · seek · A-B loop · speed · subtitles · STT · AI TTS.

Supports mp4/mkv/webm/mov/wav — will switch back to mpv automatically once the binding is fixed.
tvox_player_none_macos:
🎬 No video backend available (QtMultimedia missing + mpv disabled on macOS).

Reinstall PyQt6 in the TStudio venv: pip install --force-reinstall PyQt6
